title: Burn the Ma’at Scale Hall: Elite Lock
description: Burn the Ma’at Scale Hall: Elite Lock is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate (Stable Gate under Ma’at strain). One selected deity from Aten Ra, Sutekh, Iset, Amunet enters; this beat spotlights Sutekh as the reference silhouette while preserving player choice. The mission is the elite step at Ma’at Scale Hall, using sacred judgment temple-road descent pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light..
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Sun-Scale Verdict Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Ma’at Scale Hall and reveals: Why the Sun-Scale Gate judges travelers before admitting them. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Ma’at Scale Hall configured as a elite space inside sacred judgment temple-road descent; source-culture appearance layer: sun-scale courts, pylon shadow lanes, river-light channels, Khepri dawn engines, Ma’at seal platforms, desert storm edges; cosmetic/relic silhouettes: Ma’at was-sceptre blades, electrum wesekh source-plates, Khepri scarab cores, Uraeus counter-edict silhouettes
